policy.rule: A new test must replace a lower-value test. Raise a cap only after an explicit user request.
policy.harnessRule: The caps above count only suffix-discovered frontend tests and Rust #[test] functions. Every *.harness.* file runs under its own vitest config and is tracked in the harness section outside the 208 budget, with an exact case count and a role of entry-point or helper.
policy.harnessOpenDecision: Folding harness cases into frontendCap and totalCap is option 2 of issue #198 and remains an open repository-owner decision. This manifest records the current scope honestly and does not pre-empt that choice.
